simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְרוֹחַ (H4790) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מְרוֹחַ (mᵉrôwach) means bruised , i.e. emasculated First listed occurrence: Lev 21 20.

definitions.full: H4790. meroach [ מָרוֺחַ ] noun [masculine] dubious, only construct אָ֑שֶׁךְ מְרוֺחַ Lev 21:20 ; v either מָרַח rub = a rubbing away of the testicle ; or רָוַח be roomy, enlarged = enlargement (read then מֶרְוַח ); see further Di. מָרוֺם see רום .
